<target>##### _2.5. PREEMPTIVE MULTITASKING_

in Chapter 7. If the distinction matters, the clearest choice is to avoid the ambiguous term _context switching_ and use the more specific _thread switching_ or _process switching_ .

Thread switching is the most common form of _dispatching_ a thread, that is, of causing a processor to execute it. The only way a thread can be dispatched without a thread switch is if a processor is idle.</target>
